name: Customer completes checkout and receives downloadable tickets automatically
description: Verifies a customer can complete an M-PESA checkout, see issued tickets without pressing a status button, and return to Discover after downloading.
steps: Open a published event with available paid tickets
Choose one ticket, enter valid guest details and start M-PESA checkout
Complete the M-PESA prompt and wait for the automatic confirmation
Verify the ticket success screen displays the issued ticket and QR code without a Check Payment Status button
Download the branded PDF
expected: The ticket success screen appears automatically after confirmed payment. Downloading the PDF returns the customer to the homepage.

name: Failed or cancelled checkout can be retried without issuing unpaid tickets
covers: no ticket issuance for failed payment
description: Verifies a cancelled or failed M-PESA request displays a clear retry option and does not show tickets as paid.
steps: Open a published event with available paid tickets
Start checkout and cancel the M-PESA prompt without entering a PIN
Verify a clear payment failure message appears and no ticket is displayed
Choose Try payment again and complete a new M-PESA prompt
expected: The cancelled attempt is shown as failed with a retry option. Tickets appear only after a later payment is confirmed.

name: Organizer can configure a mobile payout destination or till number
description: Checks the organizer profile saves exactly one selected payout destination and restores it after revisiting the profile.
steps: Open Organizer profile
Choose Mobile number and enter a valid M-PESA number, then save
Switch to Till number and enter a till number, then save
Reopen the profile and verify the selected method and destination persist
expected: The selected payout method and its matching destination are saved and displayed; the unselected destination is cleared.

name: Mobile signup form scrolls independently and shows every required field
description: Verifies a narrow mobile viewport can reach all signup fields and submit the complete customer or organizer registration form without scrolling the page behind it.
steps: Open Create account on a 375 by 667 mobile viewport
Choose Organizer and scroll inside the signup panel to the bottom
Verify name, phone, organization, email, password and submit controls are reachable
Switch to Customer and verify the organization-only field is not required
expected: The signup panel scrolls internally, all applicable fields remain reachable and the page behind the open panel does not move.

name: Homepage and existing account pages retain the Tubuy Ticket experience
covers: camera QR scanning with rear-camera preference
description: Checks the existing event discovery, account, organizer, terms and scanner workflows remain intact after checkout updates.
steps: Open the homepage and search or filter the published event lineup
Sign in and open the customer ticket dashboard
Open organizer event creation, ticket categories and profile pages
Open Terms and conditions and the entry scanner
expected: Existing event discovery and account workflows remain available and retain the established Tubuy Ticket brand styling.
